; ghostbuster-settings.qmd
; Delay ghost busting when opening and closing device Settings and document settings (PDF/notebook/ebook)
; so the destination view finishes rendering before the refresh

AFFECT [[12599552112012170435]]
    TRAVERSE [[6502786168]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: settingsOpenedTimer
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 400
                ~&7083121289162&~: ~&214625660372&~
                ~&495358363329399331&~: {
                    ~&482865290967253827&~.~&8021204117616398611&~("Settings opened");
                }
            }
        }

        REPLACE [[7713401573498017]] WITH {
            function ~&7713401573498017&~(~&3011555663300085025&~) {
                settingsOpenedTimer.~&233743006639214&~();

                ~&6504254477&~.~&2766288418351025740&~.~&6504147419&~(~&"1605968110770993127&~, {
                    ~&7082453148953&~: () => {},
                    ~&7083121073606&~: () => { ~&6504254477&~.~&214622501183&~() }
                });

                ~&214622607920&~ {~&7082453764199&~, ~&214629676161&~} = ~&3011555663300085025&~;
                ~&5972376&~ (~&7082453764199&~ && ~&7082453764199&~ === ~&"17026498581215405487&~) {
                    ~&477062473974076915&~.~&17026498581215405487&~();
                    ~&7083121450889&~;
                }
                ~&5972376&~ (~&7082453764199&~ && ~&7082453764199&~ === ~&"18244511348374431282&~) {
                    ~&14975398563385417838&~ = ~&12723230021291155531&~.~&14919350785992198647&~.~&214584551776&~;
                    ~&7083121450889&~;
                }

                ~&14975398563385417838&~ = ~&214629676161&~ ?? ~&12723230021291155531&~.~&14919350785992198647&~.~&233687467065831&~;
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT [[7063364796741787792]]
    IMPORT [[233700934949963]] 2.0
    TRAVERSE [[7711468349764991]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: settingsClosedGhostTimer
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 400
                ~&7083121289162&~: ~&214625660372&~
                ~&495358363329399331&~: {
                    ~&482865290967253827&~.~&8021204117616398611&~("Settings closed");

        REPLACE [[13733777459642361598]] WITH {
            ~&13733777459642361598&~: {

END AFFECT

AFFECT [[6259312930654360789]]
    IMPORT [[233700934949963]] 2.0
    IMPORT [[197082280.8400022150001312063]] 1.0
    TRAVERSE [[7711468349764991]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property ~&6503679477&~ wasOpened: ~&214625660372&~

            ~&214604601930&~ {
                ~&5972374&~: editDocClosedGhostTimer
                ~&7713147298280334&~: 400
                ~&7083121289162&~: ~&214625660372&~
                ~&495358363329399331&~: {
                    ~&6687579895491175043&~.clearGhosting();
                }
            }
        }

        REBUILD [[7713401573498017]]
            LOCATE BEFORE STREAM \~&214622607920&~ { ~&8399386052748489877&~ } = ~&6503646550&~;\ INSERT STREAM \ ~&6504254477&~.wasOpened = ~&6504329801&~;\
        END REBUILD

        INSERT {
            ~&13733777459642361598&~: {
                ~&5972376&~ (!~&233748328658231&~ && ~&6504254477&~.wasOpened) {
                    ~&6504254477&~.wasOpened = ~&214625660372&~;
                    editDocClosedGhostTimer.~&233743006639214&~();
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
